note: Only the constitution's table of contents (article titles, incl. art. 29 freedom of expression and information) is in the passages; it states nothing about an access to information law, draft or body.

facts.fact: A draft Lei de Acesso aos Documentos e Informações Administrativas, written by a national consultant under the Pro PALOP project, was submitted to the President of the National Assembly by civil society organisations (CIP-STP, FONG-STP, PDHEG, Wêbeto) in 2018, according to STP Digital.
facts.system: Lei de Acesso a Documentos e Informações Administrativas

facts.fact: STP Digital reported on 1 December 2021 that civil society organisations were calling during the Quinzena da Cidadania (15-30 November 2021) for the draft access law to be adopted, which says it was not yet adopted.
facts.system: Lei de Acesso a Documentos e Informações Administrativas

facts.fact: UNESCO's UPR 51st session contribution states that there is no legislation concerning freedom of information in Sao Tome and Principe and recommends introducing an access to information law.
The civil-society centre CIP-STP says Sao Tome and Principe has Lei n.5/2014 on the right to information, which it calls insufficient and without effective regulation.
facts.system: Lei n.5/2014 sobre o Direito a Informacao

facts.fact: Rádio Nacional reports that civil society (CIP, via Projeto Propalop) presented a draft access to administrative information law (anteprojeto) in October 2019, still unapproved, with no specific access to information law in force in São Tomé and Príncipe.
facts.system: anteprojeto de lei de acesso à informação administrativa

facts.fact: CIPSTP formally presented its draft access to information bill to Justice Minister Vera Cruz Cravid, who received it with interest.
facts.system: draft Lei de Acesso à Informação

facts.fact: CIPSTP states São Tomé and Príncipe has no public probity law and no access to information law, and asks the National Assembly to approve one by June 2026.
facts.system: Lei de Acesso à Informação Pública e Administrativa
